svg.title: A reply with no tool calls
svg.desc: If tool markup is still in the text and finish_reason is length, the reply was cut at max_tokens and the markup is a truncated fragment. Markup without length is undecoded_tool_call: the server did not decode it. No markup and nothing after the reasoning is empty_answer. Otherwise it is a real answer.

g.text: Yes. Did it stop because finish_reason is length?

g.text: Yes: it was cut at max_tokens. The markup is a truncated fragment.

g.text: No: the server did not decode the markup. That is undecoded_tool_call.

g.text: No: the parser swallowed the reply. That is empty_answer.

svg.text: Markup and length: truncated. Markup alone: undecoded_tool_call. Nothing left: empty_answer. Else the answer.
